title: Indie Game Launch Page
limitations: 本轮按授权采用原生 HTML/CSS/ES module 无构建静态适配，而非原 prompt 的 Vite 5/React 18/TypeScript/Tailwind 3.4/Motion 栈；文档已明确。
仅依据完整已取得的公开 prompt，不声称访问或复刻付费 Pro 的未提供章节、布局或美术。
游戏与工作室为虚构概念；原 prompt 不要求可玩 demo，因此没有游戏程序；视频与商店均明确为占位。
愿望单仅在当前浏览器保存布尔值，存储被禁用时仅当前访问有效；邮件从不发送或保存，没有后台或真实邮件名单。
CC BY-NC 4.0 非商业适配；商业用途需另获许可。
仅登记默认关闭且未部署的选项；未执行构建、dist、publish、上传或任何远程部署。
summary: 已完成唯一指定英文游戏发布首页 Emberveil；原创纹理 SVG 主视觉、三组视差故事场景、诚实预告占位、可交互世界地图、季节发布信息、本地愿望单与本地表单均已实现。

visualEvidence.method: Actual final desktop.png and mobile.png were each opened with the image view tool. Map views were also opened in the preceding semantically identical CSS run.
visualEvidence.desktop: 1200×900/DPR1: clear Cinzel masthead set within original textured valley painting; balanced navigation, readable literary copy, warm CTA separation, visible lantern traveller and river; no overlap or clipping.
visualEvidence.mobile: 390×844/DPR1: readable title and wrapped hero line; stacked tap targets, compact navigation, framed traveller/lantern and scroll cue; comfortable margins and no clipping or horizontal overflow.
visualEvidence.world: Desktop lore side panel aligns with map; mobile chips remain separated and the selected lore stacks below. Warm chip focus/selection and muted background maintain hierarchy.
visualEvidence.limitations: Illustrations are original textured code-drawn SVG paintings, not private-template art or raster brush paintings.
